summary: Jin Junge of Denmark, reported missing by family Feb 4, found with his rented white Cadillac Escalade that went over the highway at Sullivan's Gulch ~2 mi south of Ouray and fell 400+ ft into the Uncompahgre River streambed; GPS equipment in the rental vehicle helped locate it; body and vehicle recovered Feb 19, 2015 after a multi-day search (crane extraction attempt failed Feb 18, closing Red Mountain Pass two days running)
location: Sullivan's Gulch, Red Mountain Pass (US-550), ~2 mi south of Ouray
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE: recorded at the missing-report date per convention; actual incident date unknown. Danish military veteran; brother told the Montrose Daily Press that Junge suffered from depression and may have taken his own life.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: peak (Uncompahgre Peak); occurrence date approximate
